name: Winds of Destiny: Rewind
source:
When Clyde (name of your choice), a young professor returning from Canada, steps back into his hometown, he’s drawn into a destiny beyond imagination. A mysterious ally unveils his calling: to stand as Savior of Humanity against an ancient power threatening to fracture reality.
Amid the quiet halls of a prestigious all-women’s Academy, Clyde balances daily life with awakening extraordinary powers. Your choices shape his journey, forging bonds with deep, authentic characters—each with secrets, fears, and desires that could alter everything.
Rewind to the origin of it all and uncover hidden truths. Dive into moments of raw emotion, tender romance, and profound intimacy where sexual and spiritual connections intertwine.
Will you rise to your divine mission and protect those you love, or surrender to greater wills? In whom will you place your trust? The winds of destiny are shifting—act now to shape their course in Winds of Destiny: Rewind.

[From [url=https://golden-novels.itch.io/winds-of-destiny-re]Itch.io[/url]]
